claimBoundary: Physics-informed, measurement-constrained period reconstruction of the OEM CGB-001 display at one fixed viewing condition; not a calibration of every surviving unit or a recovered factory specification.

sourceGeometry.scope: documented digital raster and RGB555 source contract
sourceGeometry.uncertainty: native raster and code depth are exact documented integers; nominal refresh is derived from documented CGB timing

defaultReferenceCondition.scope: accepted static reference color at the pinned source geometry
defaultReferenceCondition.uncertainty: single WIP measurement set; not an angular or multi-specimen model

defaultFrontendContract.scope: validated Gambatte libretro RGB565 transport for native CGB and explicitly GBC-colorized DMG content
defaultFrontendContract.uncertainty: the pinned Gambatte path is validated; other cores, post-processing paths, and frontend lifecycle integrations require separate receipts

generatedArtifacts.hashPolicy: The WS1 receipt hashes every verbatim color reference input and output. The WS2 receipt separately hashes the pinned core source, ROM suite, decoder, smoke report, and frontend contract. The WS3 receipt hashes the evidence/candidate records, shared constants, CPU/future-Shader fixtures, sensitivity report, and unchanged WS1 LUT. The WS4 receipt hashes its evidence/policy, 9,216-cell rate artifact, model selection, all-cell equation checks, motion fixtures, and unchanged WS1 LUT. The WS5 receipt hashes the fixed-angle exposure policy, analytic cell-crossing gold reference, fixed-quadrature/float32 equation checks, scan fixtures, and unchanged WS1/WS4 runtime artifacts. WS6 hashes the aperture evidence/model/reference and scale/phase validation. WS7 hashes the retention evidence/model/reference and topology/stress/lifecycle validation. WS8 binds all Shader, complete preset, paired RGBA8 transport textures, original float LUT/rate, model-version, source-record, and SPIR-V receipt hashes in one manifest. WS9 binds CPU gold, all-code and temporal GPU readback, aperture, texture transport, frame pacing, lifecycle, prior-art differences, target artifacts, screenshots, logs, and restoration evidence into the release receipt.

limitations: The accepted HCS source is a single WIP measurement set with recorded patch-count, black-drift, short-wavelength, negative-reflectance, additivity, and manual-processing limitations.
The exact CGB panel module, temporal response, inversion waveform, VCOM behavior, and aperture dimensions remain unavailable and must stay explicitly reconstructed or bounded.
The fixed 45 degree illumination and 0 degree normal-view reference does not predict off-axis appearance.
The WS1 32-cubed LUT is a declared measured-constrained reduction, not 32,768 direct measurements; the verbatim upstream ODS/TXT remain the source of record.
WS2 validates one pinned Gambatte libretro RGB565 path; other cores and frontends are not implicitly equivalent.
WS3 selects only period-reconstruction defaults; exact CGB LP/SPS/CLS/REVC timing, RGB555-to-six-line mapping, gamma ladder, and VCOM waveform remain unresolved.

WS4 is bounded by 6.5-inch Sharp HR-TFT family labels, not authentic CGB waveforms; direction asymmetry, per-channel timing, temperature coefficients, overshoot, and hidden LC states remain unresolved.

WS5 integrates the accepted WS1 fixed-angle XYZ field along WS4 period-reconstructed state trajectories; WS9 validates the equation on Mali-G76, but no authentic CGB response waveform has become available.
WS6 selects only a full-coverage equal-third RGB aperture; exact CGB fill, gap, notch, bus mask, MRS grain, lens, and glare remain unresolved.

WS7 uses later laboratory-cell adsorption/desorption rates only as kinetic bounds. Healthy-CGB resultant DC and optical coupling remain zero, so no aged or visibly retained reference profile is claimed.

WS9 validates one RetroArch 1.22.2/Gambatte/Vulkan/Mali-G76 target. Other frontends and GPUs require separate receipts; save-state feedback serialization remains unsupported, and background resume safely rebuilds rather than preserving ghosting history on this target.
